decision: SOURCE PASS: exact board-only sampled HALT candidate; no actionable source objection.
ordinary_bus: FX68K236 samples HALTn on phi1;2242 busAvail gates2330 canStart. S0/S2/S4 progress independent of HALT, with2337 DTACK/iStop termination; S6/SIDLE use canStart. Architectural wait occurs at2350 bus dependency, not by gating CPU phases.
rmc: 2328 rmcIdle requires SIDLE,AS low,isRmcReg;2330 explicitly bypasses busAvail.2397..2399 retains AS through read/idle. This preserves atomic continuation, not arbitrary new transactions. Bus RAM arbitration remains necessary.
sampling_limit: At phi1, Halti and busPhase updates consume old registered values. An assertion coincident with S6 may admit one already-eligible normal request; it must drain and remain visible. Source review does not promise zero-time MAME scheduler equivalence or prove the natural command path hits that coincidence.
E_VPA: Removing only MCU phase gating keeps E counter468..504 and VPA/iStop229..231/555..558 on normal enables; IACK source VPAn=!iack and DTACK inactive for IACK remain unchanged. No E-only split or donor retiming is needed for this proposal.
command_release_ownership: MCU command asserts main_halt when effective control bit4; committed P2 bit4 clear releases it, bit5 emits IRQ2 and bit6 clear emits shared_write. Existing single48MHz-domain MCU write priority at board311..322 defers a colliding CPU work service. Physical HALT alone grants no FPGA RAM ownership; those guards are preserved.
compatibility: For profiles0/1 is_stingray0 yields HALTn1; old MCU phase gate was false, so phase and enables are identical. Existing pause_game and held_reset/MCU reset behavior remain unchanged. Profile2 halt0 behavior unchanged.
comment_review: Replace Physical MCU HALT with MCU HALT request in the comment so source does not assert original PCB wiring. This is editorial; no logic objection.
physical_reference: Pinned NXP M68000 manual3.6/3.7 and table3-4 specify completing current bus on HALT and free-running E with CPU clock continuing. MAME INPUT_LINE_HALT establishes scheduler intent, not E-edge origin, real PCB wiring or electrical tri-state realization.
minimum_dynamic_checks: Observe one genuine accepted MCU command through HALT assertion and one genuine P2 release; bind command_valid/control/main_halt, actual HALTn/Halti, phase enables, busPhase/canStart/AS/lane/address/data and accepted commits. No internal state forcing or timing offset fitting.

An already-started ordinary bus must reach its normal DTACK/VPA completion and deassert AS/DS exactly once. While sampled Halti is low, no new normal bus is permitted; pending bus metadata remains intact. Record a coincident S6 start using old Halti as an allowed sampled-boundary event, not an aborted cycle or hidden mismatch.

Verify cpu_phase advances modulo8 and enPhi1/2 at phases0/4 when MCU HALT holds and pause_game is false; E/eCntr retains six-low/four-high ten-CPU-clock cadence. VPA/rVMA/xVMA/iStop continue; next IRQ/IACK is observed with actual phase, without imposing MAME E-origin equality.

At MCU shared_write or release/shared_write, verify one MCU low-byte write with preserved high byte; colliding CPU work transaction is deferred by unchanged ram_bus_service ownership and completes once afterward. Trace actual guest RAM readers/data and retained IRQ2 delivery; HALT is not itself a substitute for RAM arbitration.

Exercise RMC read/idle/write continuation if that path is included in acceptance: rmcIdle may bypass busAvail while AS stays low, retaining atomicity. Do not assert the ordinary no-new-cycle rule during this explicit continuation. BERR retry is outside this image (BERRn tied high).

Preserve Kyros profiles0/1 HALTn1 and identical phase enables, plus genuine user/OSD/hiscore pause and reset gates. Use existing bounded overlap/feature fixtures; source equivalence is not a dynamic pass.
optional_corner_fixture: A separate donor-only external HALTn pin-stimulus fixture can cover coincident S6 assertion/release if genuine MCU overlap does not. Run real FX68K with original ROM and ordinary bus, varying only the external HALT input; qualify sampled-interface behavior, not game fidelity/PCB timing. Do not add a long tuning replay or donor state force.
